questions.question: Walk me through your role in a month-end close, including the journal entries, reconciliations, and review steps you were responsible for.
In your Staff Accountant role, how did you analyze general ledger activity to prepare balance-sheet reconciliations and resolve discrepancies?
Describe a time you improved an accounting process or created a journal-entry schedule. What issue were you addressing, and what was the result?
This role requires manufacturing cost accounting. How would you approach understanding and maintaining standard costs, cost centers, and profit centers in an ERP system?
How have you used P&L analysis and variance analysis to project expenses or explain changes in financial results to business partners?
What experience do you have with inventory-related accounting, and how would you prepare for or support a physical inventory count and related reconciliation?
Describe your experience supporting year-end financial audits. What documentation did you prepare, and how did you respond to audit requests?
Which ERP and financial-reporting tools have you used, including Oracle and Hyperion? Please give an example of how you used one to improve reporting or accounting accuracy.
How would you work with Production, Engineering, and Project Managers to investigate manufacturing cost variances and develop project budgets?
This position closes under local GAAP and IFRS or US GAAP. What is your experience applying GAAP requirements, and how do you ensure financial records and reports remain compliant?
